subtitle: Car HUD, MPH Tracker, Odometer
promotionalText: Big, honest speed at a glance — HUD mode for night driving and your own speed alert. Free, no subscription, no full-screen ads.
description:
A big, clear GPS speedometer — free, no subscription, no trial.

■ READ IT AT A GLANCE
Huge numbers you can read from the corner of your eye, or a classic analog gauge with a smooth needle. MPH or km/h — tap the unit to switch.

■ HUD MODE FOR NIGHT DRIVING
Mirrored numbers on a black screen. Lay your phone under the windshield and read your speed in the reflection. No ads in HUD mode.

■ YOUR OWN SPEED ALERT
Pick a number. Go over it and the screen turns red with a short beep and a buzz — it mixes with your music and navigation instead of stopping them.

■ TRIP STATS
Top speed, average speed, distance and time, kept separately for Car, Bike, Run and Boat. Run mode shows your pace (min/mi or min/km); Boat mode uses knots and nautical miles.

■ HONEST GPS
• Shows "Weak GPS" or "No GPS signal" instead of guessing
• Reads 0 when you're stopped — no jumping numbers at red lights
• A single GPS glitch never becomes your top speed

■ SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• Works offline — speed comes from your iPhone's GPS
• Your location never leaves your iPhone. No account
• The screen stays on while the app is open

No full-screen ads, ever. Just a small banner at the bottom.

Please don't interact with your phone while driving. The app does not show road speed limits — always follow posted limits.
reviewNotes:
Speed is measured with the iPhone's GPS only while the app is open (When In Use permission; no background location). To see speed, please move (walk or drive) — when stationary it correctly shows 0.
No account or login. Location never leaves the device; the only network use is Google AdMob banner ads (no interstitial or video ads).
Differences from typical speedometer apps: no subscription or trial, honest GPS accuracy display ("Weak GPS" / "No GPS signal"), spike-filtered top speed, Car/Bike/Run (pace)/Boat (knots) modes, mirrored HUD mode and a user-set speed alert. A one-time safety notice asks users not to interact while driving. The app does not show road speed limits.
